cohort: Infants from the Growing Up in Singapore Towards healthy Outcomes (GUSTO) birth cohort (n=1033)
finding: Early-life factors like maternal tobacco smoke exposure, prenatal vitamin D insufficiency, ethnicity, and Caesarean delivery were significantly associated with the risk of teething-related pain and fever in children within the first 1.5 years of life.
mod_finding: Delivery via Caesarean section was associated with an increased risk of teething pain.
